system.description: You touch a floor or wall and listen to the building breathe.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and you also know where every living creature inside is standing.
outcomes.success: You gain a mental map of the whole structure, including secret rooms and structural weaknesses.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the time and materials are lost.
outcomes.ruin: The building learns you as you learn it: whoever owns it knows someone is coming. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
